text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fated third year—Mayano Top Gun
will surely
face many a challenge in her
senior year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I'm positive she'll emerge victorious.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! ♪ Why the stern face, Trainer? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
We're on a shrine date. You should be
smiling! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haha! That's 'cause I'm having fun.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You see, I've already decided on my
goal for this
year. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
This is the year I come out on top... I'll
beat Brian
even if she runs with all she's
got!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking about a lot of things,
but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...That's what I wanna do the most!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Heehee. I think so too. ♪
choice_data_list: You can definitely make it come true.
You can definitely make it come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I watch her smile, I give it some more
thought.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hm? What did you just say, Trainer?
choice_data_list: May you stay healthy and well just like this.
I want you to learn a lot and grow up strong.
May you grow into a wonderful adult.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! That's no fair! You can't make
your wish
before I do!
choice_data_list: I went and said a prayer.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Let's start over! We have to make our
wishes
together!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Once we make our wishes, we can move
on with
our date! ♪ Right? ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from the shrine, we
make a
quick stop at a food stall for
lunch before
heading home.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haha! You're making that face again.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hmm, it's hard to explain...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It’s like you're thinking "I wonder what I
can do
for Maya," or "I want to take care
of Maya!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I see you make that face, it
gets my
engines going. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All right, I got it! Let's start our first
training
session of the year! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We finish the year's first training session
without a
hitch.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hehe! That's not a good wish at all!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become a spectacular and
mature
woman! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, they're totally different! The
difference
between an adult and a
mature woman is...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hm, good question.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's not it! They're totally different!
They have
to be!
choice_data_list: Could it be you don't actually understand...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I find Mayano Top Gun at
the
library with her nose deep in a
dictionary.
